responsibility: Autogenerated documentation mapping for LoongArch command-line options. It associates individual -m options from loongarch.opt with URL suffixes into the rendered GCC manual, so diagnostics, help, and tooling that attach documentation links to options can point users to the correct LoongArch option reference entries.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the sibling genopts/loongarch.opt.in file, which is the source template that defines LoongArch options and their generated option records, this .urls file is a derived documentation-link map only: it lists option names and manual URL suffixes and does not declare or generate option semantics.
